tools.name: regulation_search
tools.description: Searches the clauses of the regulations the bank must follow. Returns CLAUSE_ID, REGULATION_TITLE, HEADING and TEXT.
tools.title: Regulation search

inputSchema.description:
A search query and additional parameters for search.
Specify exactly one of 'query' or 'multi_index_query'. Omit both only for a filter-only search.

query.description:
Unstructured text query. Exactly one of 'query' or 'multi_index_query' must be specified.
On a multi-index service, this query is applied to every indexed column. It cannot be used
when the service contains a vector index with user-provided embeddings. Prefer
multi_index_query to search specific indexes and limit query cost.

multi_index_query.description:
Map from indexed column name to the queries to run on that column.
Exactly one of 'query' or 'multi_index_query' must be specified.
Each value is a non-empty array of query objects, and a column may have more than one query.
Each query object sets exactly one of:
  - text: a string query. Use for a text index, a managed vector index, or a user-provided
    vector column created with a query_model for automatic embeddings.
  - vector: an array of numbers. Use for a managed vector index or a user-provided
    embedding column.
Include at least one vector index. A row is returned only when it matches every queried
field (AND across fields). Within a text field, any query term may match (OR across terms).
Example:
  {
    "name": [{"text": "sparkle"}],
    "description": [{"text": "clothing washing"}, {"vector": [0.1, 0.2]}]
  }

additionalProperties.description: Queries to run against this indexed column.

items.description: One query against this index. Set exactly one of text or vector.

vector.description: Embedding vector query against this index.

filter.description:
Filter query. Cortex Search supports filtering on the ATTRIBUTES columns specified in the CREATE CORTEX SEARCH SERVICE command.
Cortex Search supports four matching operators:
1. TEXT or NUMERIC equality: @eq
2. ARRAY contains: @contains
3. NUMERIC or DATE/TIMESTAMP greater than or equal to: @gte
4. NUMERIC or DATE/TIMESTAMP less than or equal to: @lte
These matching operators can be composed with various logical operators:
- @and
- @or
- @not
The following usage notes apply:
  Matching against NaN ('not a number') values in the source query are handled as
  described in Special values. Fixed-point numeric values with more than 19 digits (not
  including leading zeroes) do not work with @eq, @gte, or @lte and will not be returned
  by these operators (although they could still be returned by the overall query with the
  use of @not).
TIMESTAMP and DATE filters accept values of the form: YYYY-MM-DD and, for timezone
aware dates: YYYY-MM-DD+HH:MM. If the timezone offset is not specified, the date is interpreted in UTC.
These operators can be combined into a single filter object.
Example:
Filtering on rows where NUMERIC column numeric_col is between 10.5 and 12.5 (inclusive):
  { "@and": [
    { "@gte": { "numeric_col": 10.5 } },
    { "@lte": { "numeric_col": 12.5 } }
  ]}

limit.description: Max number of results to return.
